topics.label: Introduction to the Hallmarks of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the learning objectives, historical framework, and general concept of Hanahan and Weinberg's hallmarks of cancer.

topics.label: Growth Signaling Autonomy and Pathway Deregulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in cell-surface receptors and downstream cascades such as Wnt, RTK, and TGF-beta drive sustained proliferative signaling and escape from growth inhibition.

topics.label: Blockade of Terminal Cell Differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells disrupt normal tissue maturation and remain proliferative, using hematological malignancies and colonic crypt architecture as key models.

topics.label: Resistance to Programmed Cell Death
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how neoplastic cells evade apoptosis through the loss of p53 tumor suppressor activity and alterations in the Bax-BCL2 mitochondrial pathway.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Bypass
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the mechanisms of overcoming the Hayflick limit and cellular senescence via telomere maintenance and TERT activation.

topics.label: Metabolic Rewiring and the Warburg Effect
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how tumor cells alter cellular metabolism through aerobic glycolysis, enzymatic mutations, and oncometabolite signaling to support high biosynthetic demands.

topics.label: Induction of Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the necessity, timing, and regulatory balance of new blood vessel recruitment to sustain tumor oxygenation and growth.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Dynamics of Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the multi-step invasion-metastasis cascade, diagnostic tracking via lymph nodes and circulating tumor cells, and the genetic complexity underlying distant organ colonization.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Summary
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session with a summary of the hallmarks framework, references to recent literature extensions, and housekeeping remarks.
